c037.title: Uncle Ivan, the Pilot
c037.story: Max's Uncle Ivan is a [[pilot]]. One Saturday he took Max and Anna to the airport. They sat in the [[cockpit]] of his big [[jet]]. "Here is the [[radar]], and here is the [[transponder]]," he said. Anna asked, "Does the [[autopilot]] fly the plane for you?" Then they drove to a small airfield. A [[helicopter]] landed there, and its [[rotor]] was very loud. Next to it stood an old plane with a [[propeller]]. "My old teacher flies that [[glider]]," said Uncle Ivan. "He is a real [[ace]]." Then a man jumped from a plane with a red [[parachute]]. That evening Max practiced on a flight [[simulator]] for hours.

c038.title: Anna's New Smartphone
c038.story: Anna's old phone broke, so she went shopping with Max. She wanted a [[high-end]] [[smartphone]] this time. "This one has a very fast [[chip]]," the shop assistant said. He showed her the [[camera]] and its strong [[zoom]]. Anna touched the big [[touchscreen]], and the [[display]] was bright and clear. Her finger on the [[sensor]] opened the phone at once. The assistant connected her headphones by [[Bluetooth]]. He also changed her [[ringtone]] to a happy song. "It's an expensive [[device]]," Anna said quietly. "But it's the best [[gadget]] in the shop," Max said. Anna smiled and bought it.

c039.title: No Signal in the Metro
c039.story: Anna is in the metro. Her phone has no [[signal]]. There is no [[internet]] here. She cannot go [[online]]. Anna is [[offline]] for an hour. Then she walks up to the street. Her phone gets twenty [[messages|message]]. There is an [[alert]] from the group [[chat]]. Then Mama calls: "Why is your [[roaming]] on?" Anna laughs and turns it off.

c040.title: Max Fixes the Laptop
c040.story: Anna's [[laptop]] was slow and full of [[glitches|glitch]]. So she called Max, who works in [[IT]]. He connected it to his own [[computer]]. Soon he found the problem in the [[software]]. "First, let's make a [[backup]] of every [[file]]," he said. He saved them on a [[disk]] with a [[USB]] [[cable]]. Then he installed an [[update]] and did a [[reset]]. "Too many programs for one [[user]]!" Max joked. Then he showed her a keyboard [[shortcut]] for copying text. "It works like new now!" Anna said happily.

c041.title: An Email to the Professor
c041.story: Anna had to write her first [[email]] in English to a professor. She logged in to her [[account]] with her [[username]]. Then she chose a simple [[template]]. She put her name in the [[header]]. She put a [[slash]] between the day and the month. Then she attached her homework in PDF [[format]]. All evening she checked her [[inbox]], but nothing came. Max said, "Maybe his [[reply]] is in [[spam]]." He was right! The professor thanked her and sent a [[link]] to a reading list.

c042.title: Train Tickets Online
c042.story: Anna wanted train tickets to Lviv, so she tried an [[online service]]. The [[website]] opened very slowly in her [[browser]]. The [[layout]] was confusing, and she could not find the tickets. While [[browsing]], she closed three [[pop-ups|pop-up]]. Finally, with one [[click]], she bought tickets for her and Max. Then she entered the [[code]] from an [[SMS]]. She took a [[screenshot]] of the [[QR code]] for the trip. On the train, the conductor checked her phone. Anna showed him a [[scan]] of her student card too. Everything was fine, and the trip began.

c043.title: Max's Home Office
c043.story: Max's new flat had no internet. On Monday, a technician from his [[provider]] came. He brought a [[router]] and a [[modem]]. He fixed a bad [[connector]] and moved the [[antenna]] on the roof. Then Max made a small [[home office]] in his bedroom. His new [[setup]] had a big [[monitor]] and a [[headset]]. It also had a good [[microphone]] for video calls. He bought an old [[printer]], but it needed a new [[cartridge]]. Anna brought him her old [[scanner]] as a housewarming gift. "Now I can work from home!" Max said happily.

c044.title: Anna's Family Tree
c044.story: Anna draws her family tree for Max. Her parents and two [[siblings|sibling]] are on it. Aunt Olha is in her last [[trimester]]. The [[placenta]] and the [[baby]] are healthy. Soon Anna has a new [[cousin]]! "Your [[clan]] is very big!" Max says. Grandpa is an old [[admiral]], now a [[pensioner]]. He still has an old [[telephone]] at home. [[Mama|mama]] is a [[millennial]], and Grandpa is a [[boomer]]. Grandpa is an [[optimist]], but Grandma is a [[realist]]. "You have his [[genes|gene]]," Max laughs.

c045.title: A Surprise for Mama
c045.story: Anna and her brother Taras planned a [[surprise]] party for Mama's birthday. They sent an [[invite]] to the whole family. Taras ordered a big [[bouquet]] from a [[florist]] near their home. When Mama came home, everyone shouted and threw [[confetti]]. Anna gave her a [[scrapbook]] of old family photos. Mama cried happy tears. Her friend Lida brought a cake with coffee [[liqueur]]. Then they all sang [[karaoke]] until late. Then Mama paid her kids a sweet [[compliment]]: "You are the best!"

c046.title: Max Finds a Flat
c046.story: Max wanted to move out of his parents' home. A [[realtor]] showed him a [[townhouse]], but it was too expensive. Then she showed him a small [[loft]] in an old building. The [[interior]] of the building was very modern. An old [[sofa]] stood in the [[hall]] downstairs. Upstairs, the [[decor]] was simple and nice. There was a [[mini]] fridge and a [[queen-size]] bed. Max tested the [[intercom]] and the [[thermostat]]. The room was only four [[meters|meter]] wide. But Max loved the [[comfort]] of the place. "I'll take it!" he said.

c047.title: Fixing Things at Home
c047.story: Anna's dad and Taras did not want to call a [[professional]]. "We can fix the flat ourselves," Dad said. First, Taras used a [[drill]] to make holes for [[metal]] shelves. They used [[bolts|bolt]] five [[millimeters|millimeter]] wide. Then Dad repaired the [[mechanism]] in the door lock. He also checked the electrical [[panel]]. They built a small wall with concrete [[blocks|block]] and [[cement]]. Next, they painted it with [[primer]]. Their neighbor used a strong [[adhesive]] for his [[siding]]. He also had a loud concrete [[vibrator]] for his new steps. Dad laughed, "Next time, we'll ask him for help!"

c048.title: A Winter Blackout
c048.story: One cold January evening, there was a [[blackout]] in Anna's building. Dad turned on the [[generator]] in the yard. It gave a loud [[beep]] and started working. Mama lit an old [[kerosene]] lamp. Anna wrapped herself in Grandma's warm [[quilt]]. Slowly the [[boiler]] and the [[radiator]] got cold. Suddenly the smoke [[detector]] went off because of the lamp! Taras opened the window for a minute. "Don't worry, nobody will get [[hypothermia]] tonight," Mama joked. At midnight the lights came back on.
